blocks.html: This site sets no analytics, profiling or advertising cookies. It is a static site; nothing on it needs to remember you between visits.

Cloudflare may set a strictly necessary cookie (cf_clearance / __cf_bm) for security and bot mitigation. These are exempt from consent under Art. 5(3) of the ePrivacy Directive as strictly necessary for a service you requested.
Pages load web fonts from Google Fonts (fonts.googleapis.com / fonts.gstatic.com). This sends your IP address to Google but sets no cookies.
Any browser lets you block or delete cookies; blocking strictly necessary ones may prevent the site from loading.
